c6AfterThrust.label: Constellation 6 after Enigma Thrust
c6AfterThrust.reason: A Constellation 6 window of 6 seconds after her Skill, shorter than her Burst's Bogglecat Box lasts. It gives her Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks an Anemo infusion, counted when it is switched on here, and it was checked once with it on against Genshin Optimizer.
